bias.en: Pullback · testing the 30-day, under the 5 and 10-day
bias.zh: 回调 · 测试 30 日均线，位于 5 日和 10 日均线下方

read.en: Zscaler rose 0.6% on Nov 3 to $225.09, trading between $220.07 and $229.16 on light volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($238.1) and rising 10-day ($243.5) and above the rising 30-day ($221.9), 100-day ($178.9) and 200-day ($167.0) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, still above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($266.98), and RSI is 50.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月3日上涨 0.6%，收于 $225.09，盘中区间 $220.07–229.16，成交量偏低。股价位于下行的 5 日（$238.1）和上行的 10 日均线（$243.5）下方，并高于上行的 30 日（$221.9）、100 日（$178.9）和 200 日均线（$167.0）。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$266.98），RSI 为 50。

read.en: The dip to $220.07 tested and held the $220.1–221.9 support (30-day, Oct 14 low); the $229.2 high stayed under the $231.6–234.3 resistance. Resistance is $229.2–234.3 (Nov 3 high, Oct 22–30 lows), then $237.8–239 (5-day, Oct 30 close, Nov 2 high) and $241.2–243.5 (Oct 22 high, 10-day). Support is $220.1–221.9, then $214.5 and $203.3. A close above $234.3 would target $238–239; below $220, $214.5.
